rituals.unique_game_move: Start at Trigger. Stop at Close Capture. Let the middle do the work.

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Catch the thought before it becomes the room.

GAME MOVE
Start at Trigger. Stop at Close Capture. Let the middle do the work.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE FIRST FRAME // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Trigger — A trigger flickers.
2. Pause Story — Do not explain it yet.
3. Capture Thought — Pin the first mental sentence, picture, or prediction exactly as it arrived.
4. Quote — Put quotation marks around it.
5. Close Capture — The catch ends there; no life story, no courtroom, no spiral.

⚡ FINISH — Close Capture closes the round.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Before you begin Trigger, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Capture Thought, try the opposite possibility for ten seconds.
3. When you reach Close Capture, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Carry this rule with you: Catch the thought before it becomes the room.

📸 MY RESULT

rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Stop if holding the thought in mind makes you feel less steady or more upset.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.unique_game_move: Start with Imagine Trays. When Balance Verdict appears, the round is over.
rituals.recognition_cue: Use The Two-Tray Test when your mind keeps circling without finding anything new. It turns the reaction into a small experiment.
rituals.situation: Use The Two-Tray Test when your mind keeps circling without finding anything new. It turns the reaction into a small experiment.
rituals.immediate_need: A loud conclusion still has to pass inspection.

rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Emotional reasoning

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
Use The Two-Tray Test when your mind keeps circling without finding anything new. It turns the reaction into a small experiment.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A loud conclusion still has to pass inspection.

GAME MOVE
Start with Imagine Trays. When Balance Verdict appears, the round is over.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE TWO-TRAY TEST // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

1. Imagine Trays — Imagine two trays.
2. Name Sides — Name the left SUPPORTS IT and the right DOESN’T FIT.
3. Sort Facts — Drop only visible facts into them—no feelings disguised as evidence.
4. Switch Sides — Now cover the fuller tray and read the neglected one aloud.
5. Balance Verdict — Finish with a verdict that can hold both sides without pretending they weigh the same.

⚡ END MOVE — Balance Verdict. No second lap.

rituals.title: WORST CASE, WITH EXITS
rituals.name: WORST CASE, WITH EXITS
rituals.unique_game_move: Start at Name Fear and keep going only until Act Now.
rituals.recognition_cue: Worst Case, With Exits is for the moment when your mind has jumped straight to disaster—before the reaction gets to choose for you.
rituals.situation: Worst Case, With Exits is for the moment when your mind has jumped straight to disaster—before the reaction gets to choose for you.
rituals.immediate_need: A worst-case story loses size when it gains a route.
rituals.challenge: A worst-case story loses size when it gains a route.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Catastrophic prediction

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes

HOOK
Worst Case, With Exits is for the moment when your mind has jumped straight to disaster—before the reaction gets to choose for you.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A worst-case story loses size when it gains a route.

GAME MOVE
Start at Name Fear and keep going only until Act Now.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 WORST CASE, WITH EXITS // PLAY
Keep it literal. One round, then out.

1. Name Fear — Picture the feared ending in one line.
2. Build Exits — Under it build four rungs: WHAT HAPPENS; WHAT I DO NEXT; WHO OR WHAT HELPS; HOW RECOVERY COULD BEGIN.
3. Add Likely — Add a fifth rung for the outcome that is actually most likely.
4. Climb Route — Move through the five steps once in your mind.
5. Act Now — Then take the first coping action available now.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — Act Now is your cue to stop.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. As you enter Name Fear, feel where your body is supported for one moment.
2. At Add Likely, find one fact that does not fit the loudest story.
3. When you reach Act Now, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The round ends on this idea: A worst-case story loses size when it gains a route.

📸 MY RESULT
“My mind showed me disaster; I found an exit.”

rituals.plain:
WORST CASE, WITH EXITS

TRIGGER
Catastrophic prediction

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes

HOOK
Worst Case, With Exits is for the moment when your mind has jumped straight to disaster—before the reaction gets to choose for you.

GOAL
A worst-case story loses size when it gains a route.

GAME MOVE
Start at Name Fear and keep going only until Act Now.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 WORST CASE, WITH EXITS // PLAY
Keep it literal. One round, then out.

1. Name Fear — Picture the feared ending in one line.
2. Build Exits — Under it build four rungs: WHAT HAPPENS; WHAT I DO NEXT; WHO OR WHAT HELPS; HOW RECOVERY COULD BEGIN.
3. Add Likely — Add a fifth rung for the outcome that is actually most likely.
4. Climb Route — Move through the five steps once in your mind.
5. Act Now — Then take the first coping action available now.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — Act Now is your cue to stop.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. As you enter Name Fear, feel where your body is supported for one moment.
2. At Add Likely, find one fact that does not fit the loudest story.
3. When you reach Act Now, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The round ends on this idea: A worst-case story loses size when it gains a route.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You can stop at Act Now instead of feeding the pattern one more lap.

📸 MY RESULT
“My mind showed me disaster; I found an exit.”

FORMULA FLOW
Name Fear → Build Exits → Add Likely → Climb Route → Act Now

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Fear speaks in certainty; reality keeps percentages.

GAME MOVE
Give yourself one clean run: Score Odds first, Follow Evidence last.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE ODDS RECEIPT // PLAY
Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

1. Score Odds — Give the prediction a number from 0 to 100.
2. Check Baseline — Find one relevant base rate: how often has this happened in similar situations?
3. Weigh Evidence — Notice one fact that raises the odds and another that lowers them.
4. Revise Odds — Issue a revised number and date it.
5. Follow Evidence — Act from the revision, not the original alarm.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Follow Evidence, you are done.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. When you arrive at Score Odds, press both feet down for three seconds.
2. At Weigh Evidence, ask what a neutral camera could actually record.
3. When you reach Follow Evidence, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Remember the point: Fear speaks in certainty; reality keeps percentages.

📸 MY RESULT
“Fear gave me certainty. Evidence gave me odds.”

rituals.title: THE BLAME PIE
rituals.name: THE BLAME PIE
rituals.unique_game_move: Begin where it says Imagine A Pie; stop the moment you complete Choose Repair.
rituals.recognition_cue: The Blame Pie catches the moment when your mind is making you responsible for more than your share and gives you another route.
rituals.situation: The Blame Pie catches the moment when your mind is making you responsible for more than your share and gives you another route.
rituals.immediate_need: Owning your part is different from taking all the blame.
rituals.challenge: Owning your part is different from taking all the blame.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Self-blame, guilt & shame

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds

HOOK
The Blame Pie catches the moment when your mind is making you responsible for more than your share and gives you another route.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Owning your part is different from taking all the blame.

GAME MOVE
Begin where it says Imagine A Pie; stop the moment you complete Choose Repair.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE BLAME PIE // PLAY
One short round. Nothing to solve beyond the moves.

1. Imagine A Pie — Imagine a pie that stands for everything that caused the situation.
2. Share The Slices — In your mind, give slices to your choices, other people, circumstances, systems, timing, and chance.
3. Check The Whole — Make sure all slices together equal 100.
4. Find Your Slice — Focus only on your true share.
5. Choose Repair — Picture one repair for your slice. Let the rest stay outside your responsibility.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Choose Repair be enough.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Right before the first move, Imagine A Pie, let one breath happen without trying to improve it.
2. At Check The Whole, separate responsibility from punishment.
3. When you reach Choose Repair, choose one action that fits the facts you found. If you remember one thing, make it this: Owning your part is different from taking all the blame.

rituals.potency_3: When you reach Choose Repair, choose one action that fits the facts you found. If you remember one thing, make it this: Owning your part is different from taking all the blame.
rituals.win_reward:
🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You reach Choose Repair with a clearer distinction between the reaction and the response.

📸 MY RESULT
“I found my slice. I don't own the whole pie.”

GOAL

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE GREY DIAL // PLAY
Play it once. No bonus analysis.

1. Name Extremes — Name the two extremes your mind is using.
2. Build Scale — Build a 0–10 scale between them and say three real anchor points: 2, 5, and 8.
3. Place Today — Place today’s event where the evidence fits—not where the emotion shouts.
4. Choose Response — Choose a response matched to that exact setting.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Choose Response and release the exercise.
rituals.potency_stack:

1. To open Name Extremes, slow the next movement by about half.
2. At Place Today, look for the piece of evidence your first reaction ignored.
3. When you reach Choose Response, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Use this as the exit rule: Binary thinking hates a numbered dial.

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 BORROW THEIR MIRROR // PLAY
Stay with the sequence. You do not need to improve it.

1. Imagine Trusted — Imagine a trusted person bringing you the same facts.
2. Hold In Your Mind Allowances — Hold the questions you would ask them, the allowances you would make, and the evidence you would require before judging them.
3. Remove Name — Now remove their name.
4. Apply Page — Apply that page to yourself without adding a harsher clause.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Apply Page and leave the game there.

🎮 THE RULE UNDER THE RULE // PLAY
Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.

1. Picture Painful — Picture the painful thought.
2. Ask Meaning — Ask, ‘If that were true, what would it mean about me, others, or life?’ Answer quickly, then ask the same question of the answer.
3. Continue Stable — Continue only until one stable rule repeats.
4. Box — Box that rule.
5. Today — Today’s task is to inspect it, not obey it.

⚡ FINISH — Today closes the round.

The Rule Under The Rule gives you a quick reset for the moment when your mind keeps delaying the first move.

GOAL
A surface thought often works for a hidden constitution.

GAME MOVE
Move through the sequence once, from Picture Painful to Today.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE RULE UNDER THE RULE // PLAY
Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.

1. Picture Painful — Picture the painful thought.
2. Ask Meaning — Ask, ‘If that were true, what would it mean about me, others, or life?’ Answer quickly, then ask the same question of the answer.
3. Continue Stable — Continue only until one stable rule repeats.
4. Box — Box that rule.
5. Today — Today’s task is to inspect it, not obey it.

⚡ FINISH — Today closes the round.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Before you begin Picture Painful, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Continue Stable, ask, “What can I do in under two minutes?”.
3. When you reach Today, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The useful rule here is simple: A surface thought often works for a hidden constitution.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You can hold the discomfort and still make the move at Today.

📸 MY RESULT
“I stopped waiting to feel ready and found one move I could do.”

Picture Painful → Ask Meaning → Continue Stable → Box → Today

🎮 MOOD HAS ALIBIS // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

MOOD HAS ALIBIS

TRIGGER
Emotional reasoning

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

HOOK
Use Mood Has Alibis when a strong feeling is starting to sound like a fact. It turns the reaction into a small experiment.

GOAL
Test what the day does to the feeling.

GAME MOVE
One round only: enter at Choose Activity, finish at Repeat Different.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 MOOD HAS ALIBIS // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

1. Choose Activity — Choose one activity.
2. Score Expected — Before it, score expected mood; at the start, Notice actual mood; at the end, score again.
3. Add Sentence — Add one sentence about what changed during the activity.
4. Repeat Different — Repeat with three different actions before deciding ‘nothing helps.’.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Repeat Different and release the exercise.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. To open Choose Activity, slow the next movement by about half.
2. At Add Sentence, give the feeling a name without letting it make the decision.
3. When you reach Repeat Different, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Take this line with you: Test what the day does to the feeling.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
At Repeat Different, the next move feels chosen rather than dictated.

📸 MY RESULT
“The feeling was real. It still wasn't the whole evidence.”

Choose Activity → Score Expected → Add Sentence → Repeat Different

GOAL
Pleasure and mastery refuel different parts of you.

Begin with Schedule Chosen. Move straight through to Dont Demand—no extra analysing.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 TWO ENGINES // PLAY
Keep it literal. One round, then out.

1. Schedule Chosen — For the next day, schedule one act chosen purely for enjoyment and one chosen for competence.
2. Make Small — Make both small enough to happen.
3. P — After each, CHECK or M and rate whether its own channel received fuel.
4. Dont Demand — Do not demand that either activity fix everything.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Dont Demand and leave the game there.
rituals.potency_stack:

1. Give yourself one second before Schedule Chosen: soften your jaw and unclench your hands.
2. At P, ask, “What can I do in under two minutes?”.
3. When you reach Dont Demand, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The round ends on this idea: Pleasure and mastery refuel different parts of you.

🎮 BODY VETO // PLAY

4. Decide Consciously — Then decide consciously.

⚡ END MOVE — Decide Consciously. No second lap.

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 WORD MELT // PLAY
One pass is enough. Follow what is written.

1. Choose Charged — Choose one charged word—not a whole painful story.
2. Say Gently — Say it gently and steadily for about twenty seconds.
3. Listen Moment — Listen for the moment it becomes rhythm, mouth movement, or noise.
4. Stop Room — Stop there and look around the room.
5. Return Seen — Meaning may return; you have seen it separate once.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Return Seen and leave the game there.
rituals.potency_stack:

1. Give yourself one second before Choose Charged: soften your jaw and unclench your hands.

rituals.goal_why_game_move:

GAME MOVE
Move through the sequence once, from Place Thought to Allow Departure.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THOUGHT DEPARTURES // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Place Thought — Place the thought on something already moving: a bus passing, a leaf in drainage water, subtitles leaving a screen.
2. Watch Arrival — Watch its full arrival and departure without pushing it faster.
3. Return Eyes — When the carrier exits, return your eyes to one stationary object.
4. Allow Departure — Another vehicle may come; none owns the station.

⚡ FINISH — Allow Departure closes the round.

THOUGHT DEPARTURES

TRIGGER
Rigid beliefs, labels & stories

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds

HOOK
When an old rule is being treated like a fact, Thought Departures gives you something concrete to do with the moment.

GOAL
Give thought transport, not a throne.

GAME MOVE
Move through the sequence once, from Place Thought to Allow Departure.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THOUGHT DEPARTURES // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Place Thought — Place the thought on something already moving: a bus passing, a leaf in drainage water, subtitles leaving a screen.
2. Watch Arrival — Watch its full arrival and departure without pushing it faster.
3. Return Eyes — When the carrier exits, return your eyes to one stationary object.
4. Allow Departure — Another vehicle may come; none owns the station.

⚡ FINISH — Allow Departure closes the round.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Before you begin Place Thought, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Return Eyes, try the opposite possibility for ten seconds.
3. When you reach Allow Departure, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Carry this rule with you: Give thought transport, not a throne.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You can reach Allow Departure with more choice than you had at Place Thought.

📸 MY RESULT
“I found a rule I had never actually chosen.”

FORMULA FLOW
Place Thought → Watch Arrival → Return Eyes → Allow Departure

PLAY TIME

HOOK
The Life Direction Test is for the moment when the immediate feeling has pulled you away from what matters—before the reaction gets to choose for you.

Use Picture as the doorway and Select Direction as the exit.

🎮 THE LIFE DIRECTION TEST // PLAY
Keep it literal. One round, then out.

1. Picture — Picture two arrows.
2. Make Room — One shows the next hour if you obey the thought; the other reveals what unfolds over sixty minutes when you make room for it but follow a chosen value.
3. Name Likely — Name the likely behaviour at each arrow’s end.
4. Select Direction — Select by direction, not by mental volume.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — Select Direction is your cue to stop.

1. As you enter Picture, feel where your body is supported for one moment.
2. At Name Likely, separate responsibility from punishment.
3. When you reach Select Direction, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The round ends on this idea: A thought can sound true and still drive badly.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You can stop at Select Direction instead of feeding the pattern one more lap.

📸 MY RESULT
“I chose one move that matched what matters to me.”

🎮 PASSENGER THOUGHT // PLAY
Play it once. No bonus analysis.

1. Choose Time — Choose one two-minute action that matters.
2. Ride Passenger — Invite the thought to ride in the passenger seat—audible, uncomfortable, unedited.
3. Keep Hands — Keep hands on the action wheel and complete the movement while it talks.
4. Actually — At the destination, Notice who actually drove.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Actually and release the exercise.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. To open Choose Time, slow the next movement by about half.
2. At Keep Hands, ask, “What can I do in under two minutes?”.
3. When you reach Actually, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Use this as the exit rule: You do not need an empty vehicle to steer.

GOAL
Capacity grows sideways, not through force.

Begin with Locate Unwanted. Move straight through to Enlarging—no extra analysing.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 MAKE A WIDER CONTAINER // PLAY
Stay with the sequence. You do not need to improve it.

1. Locate Unwanted — Locate the unwanted sensation.
2. Find Edges — Find its edges.
3. Soften Muscles — Soften the muscles around—not inside—it.
4. Include Neutral — Include one neutral body area and one external sound in awareness.
5. Enlarging — You are enlarging the room, not evicting the guest.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Enlarging and leave the game there.
rituals.potency_stack:

1. Give yourself one second before Locate Unwanted: soften your jaw and unclench your hands.
2. At Soften Muscles, separate responsibility from punishment.
3. When you reach Enlarging, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Leave the exercise with this: Capacity grows sideways, not through force.

TRIGGER
Urges, impulses & cravings

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
When the urge feels like an instruction, Ride The Craving Graph helps you test what your mind is telling you.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
An urge is a curve pretending to be a command.

GAME MOVE
Touch Level, follow the moves, and finish on Choose Time.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 RIDE THE CRAVING GRAPH // PLAY
Play the moves, not the whole life story.

1. Level — Notice its current level and where it moves in the body.
2. Watch Slope — Watch for slope: rising, flattening, cresting, falling.
3. Imagine Urge — Every thirty seconds, Imagine the next point without acting on the urge.
4. Name Change — When the line changes direction, name the change.
5. Choose Time — Choose what protects the next hour.

⚡ DONE — Complete Choose Time, then return to your day.

rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Perfectionism & performance pressure

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

HOOK
Try Close One Door For Thirty Seconds when every option feels too important to choose. It creates just enough space for a different response.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A hidden preference often speaks when one door briefly closes.

GAME MOVE
Start with Close Door. When Choose Next appears, the round is over.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 CLOSE ONE DOOR FOR THIRTY SECONDS // PLAY
Follow the sequence once; leave the rest alone.

1. Close Door — Picture the two leading options. Cross out one for thirty seconds and pretend it is unavailable; do not commit.
2. Read Protest — Notice the first specific reaction—relief, disappointment, bargaining, urgency, or no change. Name it in four words or fewer.
3. Reopen Choice — Uncross the option. Repeat once with the other door closed so both reactions receive the same test.
4. Choose Next — Use the clearer reaction as one piece of data, then choose only the next responsible move.

⚡ END MOVE — Choose Next. No second lap.

1. Just before you start Close Door, notice one sound in the room before continuing.
2. At Reopen Choice, ask, “What can I do in under two minutes?”.
3. When you reach Choose Next, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Your takeaway: A hidden preference often speaks when one door briefly closes.

📸 MY RESULT

Values become real only after the body votes.

Give yourself one clean run: Choose Value first, Tiny last.

🎮 ONE VISIBLE VOTE // PLAY
Run the game exactly once, lightly.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Tiny, you are done.

1. When you arrive at Choose Value, press both feet down for three seconds.
2. At Complete Shift, try the opposite possibility for ten seconds.

By Tiny, the first reaction is no longer the only move on the table.

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A single moment cannot legally seize your whole identity.

GAME MOVE
Let Carry Qualities begin the game. Let Ask Part end it.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 MORE THAN THIS STATE // PLAY
Keep it literal. One round, then out.

1. Carry Qualities — Name three roles you carry, two qualities others have witnessed, and one state present today.
2. Imagine Large — Imagine a large Focus on around all six.
3. Place Painful — Place the current painful content inside, not across, the boundary.
4. Ask Part — Ask which part of the larger system should lead the next action.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Ask Part and leave the game there.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Give yourself one second before Carry Qualities: soften your jaw and unclench your hands.
2. At Place Painful, separate responsibility from punishment.
3. When you reach Ask Part, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The round ends on this idea: A single moment cannot legally seize your whole identity.

rituals.name: RETURN WITHOUT A TRIAL
rituals.unique_game_move: Enter through State Off; leave as soon as you reach No. One pass is enough.
rituals.recognition_cue: When the immediate feeling has pulled you away from what matters, try Return Without A Trial. It makes the pattern easier to see and harder to obey.
rituals.situation: When the immediate feeling has pulled you away from what matters, try Return Without A Trial. It makes the pattern easier to see and harder to obey.
rituals.immediate_need: Drift needs a direction change, not a prosecution.
rituals.challenge: Drift needs a direction change, not a prosecution.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Values, meaning & loss

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds

HOOK
When the immediate feeling has pulled you away from what matters, try Return Without A Trial. It makes the pattern easier to see and harder to obey.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Drift needs a direction change, not a prosecution.

GAME MOVE
Enter through State Off; leave as soon as you reach No. One pass is enough.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 RETURN WITHOUT A TRIAL // PLAY
Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

1. State Off — State what moved off course in plain language.
2. Delete — Delete every adjective about your character.
3. Name Value — Name the value still available and take its nearest next action.
4. Move Whether — Only after moving, decide whether the plan needs repair.
5. No — No verdict is required for re-entry.

⚡ DONE — Complete No, then return to your day.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. At the start of State Off, widen your gaze and notice the edges of the room.
2. At Name Value, separate responsibility from punishment.
3. When you reach No, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Remember the point: Drift needs a direction change, not a prosecution.

rituals.title: THE THIRD VOICE
rituals.name: THE THIRD VOICE
rituals.unique_game_move: Move through the sequence once, from Open Voices to Use Wisdom.
rituals.recognition_cue: The Third Voice catches the moment when a strong feeling is starting to sound like a fact and gives you another route.
rituals.situation: The Third Voice catches the moment when a strong feeling is starting to sound like a fact and gives you another route.
rituals.immediate_need: Emotion and logic are witnesses; wisdom gives the final answer.
rituals.challenge: Emotion and logic are witnesses; wisdom gives the final answer.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Emotional reasoning

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
The Third Voice catches the moment when a strong feeling is starting to sound like a fact and gives you another route.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Emotion and logic are witnesses; wisdom gives the final answer.

GAME MOVE
Move through the sequence once, from Open Voices to Use Wisdom.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE THIRD VOICE // PLAY
One short round. Nothing to solve beyond the moves.

1. Open Voices — Complete three lines.
2. Name Feeling — FEELING SAYS: include its full truth.
3. Name Facts — FACTS SAY: include only verified information.
4. Build Wisdom — WISE RESPONSE: honour the need in the first line and the constraints in the second.
5. Use Wisdom — Read only the third line before acting.

⚡ FINISH — Use Wisdom closes the round.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Before you begin Open Voices, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Name Facts, give the feeling a name without letting it make the decision.
3. When you reach Use Wisdom, choose one action that fits the facts you found. If you remember one thing, make it this: Emotion and logic are witnesses; wisdom gives the final answer.

rituals.win_reward:
🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You arrive at Use Wisdom with less need to obey the first answer.

📸 MY RESULT
“The feeling was real. It still wasn't the whole evidence.”
rituals.formula_flow: Open Voices → Name Feeling → Name Facts → Build Wisdom → Use Wisdom

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Stop watching yourself do the thing; do the thing.

GAME MOVE
Use Choose Ordinary as the doorway and Participation as the exit.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 ENTER THE ACTION // PLAY
Stay with the sequence. You do not need to improve it.

1. Choose Ordinary — Choose one ordinary activity.
2. Place Vision — Place vision, touch, posture, and hearing inside it.
3. Leave Re — When attention leaves, re-enter through the next physical contact point rather than scolding yourself.
4. Stay Activity — Stay until the activity reaches its natural edge.
5. Participation — Participation, not perfect focus, is the target.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — Participation is your cue to stop.

🎮 TRANSLATE THE VERDICT // PLAY
Play the moves, not the whole life story.

1. Take Judgement — Take one judgement and rewrite it as three components: visible facts, personal preference, likely consequence.

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 OBJECTIVE OVER EGO // PLAY
Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.

1. Picture Real — Picture the real objective in seven words or fewer.
2. Name — Name the action that advances it and the action that merely wins, punishes, impresses, or avoids embarrassment.
3. Imagine Tomorrow — Imagine tomorrow’s result after each.
4. Select Works — Select what works, even if the ego receives no trophy.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Select Works be enough.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 ONE CLEAN WISH // PLAY
Run the game exactly once, lightly.

1. Bring Person — Bring the person to mind at a safe distance.
2. Dont Deny — Choose one honest wish that does not deny harm: ‘May we both be free from causing more suffering,’ or ‘May safety become possible.’ Offer it once.
3. State Boundary — Then state the boundary or action you still need.
4. Dont Cancel — Warmth does not cancel discernment.

⚡ DONE — Complete Dont Cancel, then return to your day.

rituals.unique_game_move: Start at Release Forehead. Stop at Ask Whether. Let the middle do the work.
rituals.recognition_cue: When your body alarm keeps turning itself up, The 2% Softening gives you something concrete to do with the moment.
rituals.situation: When your body alarm keeps turning itself up, The 2% Softening gives you something concrete to do with the moment.

rituals.challenge: Your face can send the nervous system a quieter memo.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Panic & body alarm

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

HOOK
When your body alarm keeps turning itself up, The 2% Softening gives you something concrete to do with the moment.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Your face can send the nervous system a quieter memo.

GAME MOVE
Start at Release Forehead. Stop at Ask Whether. Let the middle do the work.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE 2% SOFTENING // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Release Forehead — Without forcing happiness, release the forehead, loosen the eyes, and lift the mouth corners by only two percent.
2. Keep Expression — Keep the expression believable.
3. Hold Neutral — Hold it while looking at one neutral object.
4. Ask Whether — Ask whether defence changed by even half a notch.

⚡ FINISH — Ask Whether closes the round.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Before you begin Release Forehead, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Hold Neutral, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach Ask Whether, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Carry this rule with you: Your face can send the nervous system a quieter memo.

📸 MY RESULT
“My body sounded an alarm; I didn't have to turn it into danger.”

rituals.unique_game_move: Start with Set Code. When Claim Control appears, the round is over.
rituals.recognition_cue: Use Play The Body Password when your body alarm keeps turning itself up. It turns the reaction into a small experiment.

rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Panic & body alarm

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds

HOOK
Use Play The Body Password when your body alarm keeps turning itself up. It turns the reaction into a small experiment.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A short body code can prove that alarm has not taken every control.

GAME MOVE
Start with Set Code. When Claim Control appears, the round is over.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 PLAY THE BODY PASSWORD // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

1. Set Code — Choose three tiny comfortable movements, such as tap a knee, touch a thumb, and look at one fixed object. Say the order once.
2. Run Order — Perform A–B–C slowly, pausing after each movement long enough to feel it finish.
3. Reverse Code — Perform C–B–A at the same pace. If you lose the order, return to neutral and restart instead of speeding up.
4. Claim Control — Name the movement you directed most clearly, then let the whole code stop.

⚡ END MOVE — Claim Control. No second lap.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Just before you start Set Code, notice one sound in the room before continuing.
2. At Reverse Code, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach Claim Control, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Take this line with you: A short body code can prove that alarm has not taken every control.

Start with Set Code. When Claim Control appears, the round is over.

🎮 PLAY THE BODY PASSWORD // PLAY

2. Run Order — Perform A–B–C slowly, pausing after each movement long enough to feel it finish.
3. Reverse Code — Perform C–B–A at the same pace. If you lose the order, return to neutral and restart instead of speeding up.
4. Claim Control — Name the movement you directed most clearly, then let the whole code stop.

⚡ END MOVE — Claim Control. No second lap.

1. Just before you start Set Code, notice one sound in the room before continuing.
2. At Reverse Code, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach Claim Control, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Take this line with you: A short body code can prove that alarm has not taken every control.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
At Claim Control, you have at least one option the first reaction did not show you.

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE FOUR-LETTER BRAKE // PLAY
Keep it literal. One round, then out.

1. Stop Nonessential — S — stop every nonessential movement.
2. Take Physical — T — take one physical step back.
3. Observe Facts — O — observe facts, sensations, and the strongest impulse.
4. Proceed Safely — P — proceed with the smallest safe move that will still make sense in an hour.
5. Dont Negotiate — Do not negotiate with momentum between letters.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — Dont Negotiate is your cue to stop.

rituals.unique_game_move: Give yourself one clean run: Use Cool first, Test Endurance last.

about 1 minute

HOOK

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 COOL THE ALARM PANEL // PLAY
Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

1. Use Cool — Use cool—not painfully cold—water or a wrapped cool pack on the cheeks and around the eyes for a brief interval.
2. Slow — Slow your body while the sensation lands.
3. Remove Name — Remove it, name the room, and reassess the next safe action.
4. Test Endurance — Cooling is a reset cue, not a test of endurance.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Test Endurance, you are done.

2. At Remove Name, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach Test Endurance, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Remember the point: Temperature can reach body alarm before language does.

rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Urgency & decision pressure

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

HOOK
If the fastest response feels like the only response, The Longer Out-Breath turns the mental noise into one playable move.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Make urgency leave through a gentler exit.

GAME MOVE
Play from Breathe Pulling to Breathe Workable. Treat the last move as the finish line.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE LONGER OUT-BREATH // PLAY
Play it once. No bonus analysis.

1. Breathe Pulling — Breathe in without pulling extra air.
2. Let Outflow — Let the outflow last slightly longer, as though fogging a distant window silently.
3. Repeat Comfortable — Repeat only while comfortable; keep shoulders quiet and jaw loose.
4. Breathe Workable — After several rounds, resume natural breathing and look for one workable decision.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Breathe Workable and release the exercise.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. To open Breathe Pulling, slow the next movement by about half.
2. At Repeat Comfortable, ask, “What can I do in under two minutes?”.
3. When you reach Breathe Workable, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Use this as the exit rule: Make urgency leave through a gentler exit.

Comparison & rejection

about 90 seconds

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Acceptance is often a direction repeated, not a mood achieved.

GAME MOVE
Run the sequence once. Catch Mind opens it; Return Wheel closes it.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 TURN AGAIN // PLAY
Run the game exactly once, lightly.

1. Catch Mind — Catch the mind reopening the case against what has already occurred.
2. Name Refusal — Name the refusal without criticism.
3. Rotate Attention — Rotate attention toward the existing fact and the action now possible.
4. Return Wheel — Each return is one turn of the wheel; stop counting after the chosen behaviour begins.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Return Wheel, you are done.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. When you arrive at Catch Mind, press both feet down for three seconds.
2. At Rotate Attention, separate responsibility from punishment.
3. When you reach Return Wheel, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Keep only this lesson: Acceptance is often a direction repeated, not a mood achieved.

📸 MY RESULT

rituals.unique_game_move: Open at Separate Cards; close at Update Meaning. Keep it light and literal.

rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Emotional reasoning

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
When a strong feeling is starting to sound like a fact, Does The Feeling Fit The File? gives you something concrete to do with the moment.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Emotion deserves respect; facts determine the dose.

GAME MOVE
Open at Separate Cards; close at Update Meaning. Keep it light and literal.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 DOES THE FEELING FIT THE FILE? // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Separate Cards — Separate four cards: prompting event, meaning, verified evidence, actual present threat.
2. Compare Emotion — Compare the emotion’s intensity and duration with the fourth card.
3. Use Feeling — If they fit, use the feeling’s message.
4. Update Meaning — If they exceed it, regulate first and update the meaning.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Update Meaning be enough.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Right before the first move, Separate Cards, let one breath happen without trying to improve it.
2. At Use Feeling, give the feeling a name without letting it make the decision.
3. When you reach Update Meaning, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Carry this rule with you: Emotion deserves respect; facts determine the dose.

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 CHECK THE BIOLOGICAL VOLUME KNOBS // PLAY
One short round. Nothing to solve beyond the moves.

1. Review — Review five amplifiers: illness or pain; missed food or hydration; substances or withdrawal; sleep debt; movement deficit or excess.
2. Identify Strongest — Spot the strongest correctable factor.
3. Make Health — Make one health-supporting adjustment before treating the entire reaction as psychological truth.

⚡ FINISH — Make Health closes the round.

rituals.game_move: Start at Select Task and keep going only until Challenge.
rituals.how_to_play:
🎮 ONE INCH BEYOND EASY // PLAY
Stay with the sequence. You do not need to improve it.

1. Select Task — Select a task you can already do.
2. Increase — Increase one dimension slightly: duration, complexity, independence, or visibility.
3. Complete Version — Complete that version and Keep what skill carried you through.
4. Challenge — The next challenge must be earned by evidence, not demanded by shame.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — Challenge is your cue to stop.
rituals.power_up_1: As you enter Select Task, feel where your body is supported for one moment.
rituals.power_up_2: At Complete Version, separate responsibility from punishment.
rituals.power_up_3: When you reach Challenge, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Leave the exercise with this: Competence grows at the edge, not at the cliff.
rituals.win_reward_raw:
🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You can do Challenge while some discomfort is still present.

📸 MY RESULT
“Something happened. It wasn't a definition of me.”
rituals.formula_flow_raw: Select Task → Increase → Complete Version → Challenge

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 PUT GOOD ON THE CALENDAR // PLAY
Play the moves, not the whole life story.

1. Choose Genuinely — Choose one genuinely reinforcing experience; assign it a time, place, and first action.
2. Protect Appointment — Protect the appointment from unnecessary multitasking.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Afterward, you are done.

rituals.unique_game_move: Begin where it says Drop Define; stop the moment you complete Dont Keep.
rituals.recognition_cue: Feeling Or Fixing? gives you a quick reset for the moment when your body alarm keeps turning itself up.
rituals.situation: Feeling Or Fixing? gives you a quick reset for the moment when your body alarm keeps turning itself up.
rituals.immediate_need: Regulate first; solve only what is solvable.
rituals.challenge: Regulate first; solve only what is solvable.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Panic & body alarm

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

HOOK
Feeling Or Fixing? gives you a quick reset for the moment when your body alarm keeps turning itself up.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Regulate first; solve only what is solvable.

GAME MOVE
Begin where it says Drop Define; stop the moment you complete Dont Keep.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 FEELING OR FIXING? // PLAY
Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.

1. Drop Define — After body alarm drops, define the obstacle without emotional adjectives.
2. Ask Whether — Ask whether a specific action could change it.
3. Choose Action — If yes, choose and schedule that action.
4. Return Acceptance — If no, return to acceptance or support.
5. Dont Keep — Do not keep using soothing when the door requires a key.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Dont Keep be enough.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Right before the first move, Drop Define, let one breath happen without trying to improve it.
2. At Choose Action, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach Dont Keep, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The useful rule here is simple: Regulate first; solve only what is solvable.

📸 MY RESULT
“My body sounded an alarm; I didn't have to turn it into danger.”

Play from Identify Chapter to Continue Genuine. Treat the last move as the finish line.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 LET THE EMOTION FINISH ONE CHAPTER // PLAY

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Teach the body that a safe signal is not worst-case story.

GAME MOVE
Move through the sequence once, from Select Medically to Test Sensation.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 BORROW THE SENSATION // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Select Medically — Select a medically safe exercise that creates a mild feared sensation—brief spinning, stair walking, or breathing through a narrow straw only when appropriate.
2. Test Sensation — Predict what will happen, induce the sensation briefly, and observe recovery without usual calming it.

⚡ FINISH — Test Sensation closes the round.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Before you begin Select Medically, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Test Sensation, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach Test Sensation, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Carry this rule with you: Teach the body that a safe signal is not worst-case story.

📸 MY RESULT

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 LEAVE ONE QUESTION OPEN // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

1. Choose Low — Choose a low-stakes unknown.
2. Picture Card — Picture it on a card and forbid checking, asking, or mentally solving until a set time.

rituals.text_plain:
DESIGN THE SURPRISE

TRIGGER
Emotional reasoning

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
When a strong feeling is starting to sound like a fact, try Design The Surprise. It makes the pattern easier to see and harder to obey.

GOAL
Exposure works when reality breaks the prediction.

GAME MOVE
Run the sequence once. Picture Strongest opens it; Hold In Your Mind Expected closes it.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 DESIGN THE SURPRISE // PLAY
Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

1. Picture Strongest — Picture the strongest testable forecast in visible terms.
2. Build Safe — Build a safe exposure aimed at that exact claim, not merely at feeling anxious.
3. Hold In Your Mind Expected — Afterward, Keep what was expected, what occurred, and what the old model cannot easily explain.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Hold In Your Mind Expected, you are done.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. When you arrive at Picture Strongest, press both feet down for three seconds.
2. At Build Safe, give the feeling a name without letting it make the decision.
3. When you reach Hold In Your Mind Expected, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Remember the point: Exposure works when reality breaks the prediction.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
The move at Hold In Your Mind Expected feels more deliberate than automatic.

📸 MY RESULT
“The feeling was real. It still wasn't the whole evidence.”

FORMULA FLOW
Picture Strongest → Build Safe → Hold In Your Mind Expected

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE TWO-CUE MERGE // PLAY
Stay with the sequence. You do not need to improve it.

1. Select Triggers — Select two triggers already tolerable separately.
2. Predict Joining — Predict what joining them will add.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Stay Long and leave the game there.

rituals.title: FINISH THE LOOK
rituals.name: FINISH THE LOOK
rituals.unique_game_move: Start at Let Eyes. Stop at Place Attention. Let the middle do the work.
rituals.recognition_cue: Finish The Look gives you a quick reset for the moment when your mind keeps circling without finding anything new.
rituals.situation: Finish The Look gives you a quick reset for the moment when your mind keeps circling without finding anything new.
rituals.immediate_need: Defence narrows the world; sense of where you are reopens it.
rituals.challenge: Defence narrows the world; sense of where you are reopens it.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Body-state misreading

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
Finish The Look gives you a quick reset for the moment when your mind keeps circling without finding anything new.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Defence narrows the world; sense of where you are reopens it.

GAME MOVE
Start at Let Eyes. Stop at Place Attention. Let the middle do the work.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 FINISH THE LOOK // PLAY
Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.

1. Let Eyes — Let your eyes move before your head.
2. Scan Left — Slowly scan left, centre, right, behind if safe, and toward an exit.
3. Name Cues — Name present cues of choice, support, and distance from threat.
4. Allow Neck — Allow the neck to follow only within comfort.
5. Place Attention — End by selecting where attention belongs now.

⚡ FINISH — Place Attention closes the round.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Before you begin Let Eyes, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Name Cues, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
3. When you reach Place Attention, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The useful rule here is simple: Defence narrows the world; sense of where you are reopens it.

Avoid head movement with injury, dizziness, or driving.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.
rituals.plain:
FINISH THE LOOK

TRIGGER
Body-state misreading

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
Finish The Look gives you a quick reset for the moment when your mind keeps circling without finding anything new.

GOAL
Defence narrows the world; sense of where you are reopens it.

GAME MOVE
Start at Let Eyes. Stop at Place Attention. Let the middle do the work.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 FINISH THE LOOK // PLAY
Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.

1. Let Eyes — Let your eyes move before your head.
2. Scan Left — Slowly scan left, centre, right, behind if safe, and toward an exit.
3. Name Cues — Name present cues of choice, support, and distance from threat.
4. Allow Neck — Allow the neck to follow only within comfort.
5. Place Attention — End by selecting where attention belongs now.

⚡ FINISH — Place Attention closes the round.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Before you begin Let Eyes, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Name Cues, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
3. When you reach Place Attention, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The useful rule here is simple: Defence narrows the world; sense of where you are reopens it.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You can hold the discomfort and still make the move at Place Attention.

📸 MY RESULT
“I stopped circling and found the next useful point.”

FORMULA FLOW
Let Eyes → Scan Left → Name Cues → Allow Neck → Place Attention

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Regulation can be built by travelling, not staying still.

GAME MOVE
Start with Find Activated. When Finish Whichever appears, the round is over.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 PENDULUM BETWEEN TWO TRUTHS // PLAY
Follow the sequence once; leave the rest alone.

1. Find Activated — Find one activated region and another settled or supported area.
2. Move Resource — Touch the difficult region with attention for a few seconds, then move to the resource.
3. Travel — Travel back and forth at a pace that preserves choice.
4. Finish Whichever — Finish on whichever location offers steadier sense of where you are.

⚡ END MOVE — Finish Whichever. No second lap.

2. At Travel, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach Finish Whichever, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Your takeaway: Regulation can be built by travelling, not staying still.

rituals.name: ONE DROP, NOT THE OCEAN
rituals.unique_game_move: Start at Choose Tiniest and keep going only until Use Less.
rituals.recognition_cue: When a body sensation is being treated like proof of danger, One Drop, Not The Ocean makes the invisible part of the pattern easier to catch.
rituals.situation: When a body sensation is being treated like proof of danger, One Drop, Not The Ocean makes the invisible part of the pattern easier to catch.
rituals.immediate_need: Small contact can process what flooding cannot.
rituals.challenge: Small contact can process what flooding cannot.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Body-state misreading

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes

HOOK
When a body sensation is being treated like proof of danger, One Drop, Not The Ocean makes the invisible part of the pattern easier to catch.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Small contact can process what flooding cannot.

GAME MOVE
Start at Choose Tiniest and keep going only until Use Less.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 ONE DROP, NOT THE OCEAN // PLAY
One pass is enough. Follow what is written.

1. Choose Tiniest — Choose the tiniest fragment of the difficult material: one edge, colour, word, or body sensation.
2. Return Fully — Contact it briefly, then return fully to a stabilising cue.
3. Hold In Your Mind Dose — Hold the dose that allowed recovery.
4. Use Less — Next practice uses the same or less—not an ambitious leap.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — Use Less is your cue to stop.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. As you enter Choose Tiniest, feel where your body is supported for one moment.
2. At Hold In Your Mind Dose, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach Use Less, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Let this be the line you keep: Small contact can process what flooding cannot.

📸 MY RESULT

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 TRACK WHAT HOLDS // PLAY
Run the game exactly once, lightly.

1. Locate Bodily — Locate one bodily sign of steadiness—warmth, pressure, uprightness, ease, or a capable impulse.
2. Describe Boundaries — Say its boundaries and changes for twenty seconds.
3. Ask Memory — Ask what memory, person, posture, or environment strengthens it by one degree.
4. Add Ingredient — Add only that ingredient.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Add Ingredient, you are done.

rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Panic & body alarm

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds

HOOK
When your body position is helping the mood stay stuck, Wait For The Whole Body Answer gives you something concrete to do with the moment.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Some experience forms before it can be explained.

GAME MOVE
Begin where it says Bring Mind; stop the moment you complete Dont Improve.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 WAIT FOR THE WHOLE BODY ANSWER // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Bring Mind — Bring the issue to mind lightly, then pause verbal analysis.
2. Ask Body — Ask the body, ‘What is the whole of this like?’ Wait for an image, phrase, posture, or global texture.
3. Check Whether — Check whether it fits by noticing a small inner yes, no, or shift.
4. Dont Improve — Do not improve the answer.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Dont Improve be enough.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Right before the first move, Bring Mind, let one breath happen without trying to improve it.
2. At Check Whether, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach Dont Improve, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Carry this rule with you: Some experience forms before it can be explained.

📸 MY RESULT
“A small body shift changed the way the moment felt.”

Boundaries can be measured before they are argued.

GAME MOVE
Let Use Object begin the game. Let Distance end it.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 FIND THE BODY’S WORKABLE DISTANCE // PLAY
Keep it literal. One round, then out.

1. Use Object — Using an object, doorway, or trusted person with consent, test near and far in small increments.
2. Breath — Notice breath, posture, urge, and clarity at each point.
3. Body — Notice where the body can stay present and communicate.
4. Distance — That distance is data, not a permanent verdict.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Distance and leave the game there.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Give yourself one second before Use Object: soften your jaw and unclench your hands.
2. At Body, give the feeling a name without letting it make the decision.
3. When you reach Distance, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The round ends on this idea: Boundaries can be measured before they are argued.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You can get from Use Object to Distance without adding another story on top.

📸 MY RESULT
“I had an urge. I didn't have to become it.”

FORMULA FLOW
Use Object → Breath → Body → Distance

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL

GAME MOVE
Move through the sequence once, from Smallest to Let Determine.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 TURN UP THE WHISPER // PLAY
One short round. Nothing to solve beyond the moves.

1. Smallest — Notice the smallest spontaneous tendency: sway, curl, stretch, turn, reach.
2. Pause Enlarge — Enlarge it by only ten percent and pause.
3. Ask Whether — Ask whether it brings ease, protection, energy, or nothing.
4. Let Determine — Let the answer determine whether to continue, reverse, or stop.

⚡ FINISH — Let Determine closes the round.

🎮 THEN / NOW SUBTITLES // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

2. Include Age — Include age, place, available help, bodily freedom, and exits.
3. Keep Eyes — Keep eyes open and touch the environment after every pair.
4. Date Location — The screen may replay; the subtitles restore date and location.

⚡ END MOVE — Date Location. No second lap.

1. Just before you start Alternate Lines, notice one sound in the room before continuing.

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A memory matters without every detail carrying equal certainty.

GAME MOVE
Give yourself one clean run: Pick Detail first, Keep Core last.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 STAMP WHERE THE DETAIL CAME FROM // PLAY
Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

1. Pick Detail — Choose one small memory detail; do not replay the event.
2. Tag Source — Stamp it SENSED, INFERRED, LEARNED LATER, or UNSURE.
3. Rate Confidence — Give the detail a confidence word—high, medium, low, or unknown—based on its source rather than its emotional intensity.
4. Keep Core — Picture one core fact that remains reliable and let the other detail keep its honest uncertainty.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Keep Core, you are done.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. When you arrive at Pick Detail, press both feet down for three seconds.
2. At Rate Confidence, try the opposite possibility for ten seconds.
3. When you reach Keep Core, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Remember the point: A memory matters without every detail carrying equal certainty.

3. Rate Confidence — Give the detail a confidence word—high, medium, low, or unknown—based on its source rather than its emotional intensity.
4. Keep Core — Picture one core fact that remains reliable and let the other detail keep its honest uncertainty.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Keep Core, you are done.

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Not every unsettled breath needs a longer exhale.

GAME MOVE
Play from Observe Ordinary to Check Whether. Treat the last move as the finish line.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 FIND THE BUSY HALF // PLAY
Play it once. No bonus analysis.

1. Observe Ordinary — Observe three ordinary cycles.
2. Rate Inhale — Rate inhale effort and exhale release separately.
3. Phase — Which phase is working too hard?
4. Leave Timing — Ease only that side toward neutral—less pulling in or less pushing out—while leaving timing alone.
5. Check Whether — Check whether urgency changes when imbalance decreases.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Check Whether and release the exercise.

rituals.unique_game_move: Let Choose Slow begin the game. Let Continue Long end it.
rituals.recognition_cue: Rhythm Before Depth works best when your body alarm keeps turning itself up. The goal is not to win an argument with your mind—just change the next move.
rituals.situation: Rhythm Before Depth works best when your body alarm keeps turning itself up. The goal is not to win an argument with your mind—just change the next move.
rituals.immediate_need: A sustainable cadence can organise the whole system.
rituals.challenge: A sustainable cadence can organise the whole system.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Panic & body alarm

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes

HOOK
Rhythm Before Depth works best when your body alarm keeps turning itself up. The goal is not to win an argument with your mind—just change the next move.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A sustainable cadence can organise the whole system.

GAME MOVE
Let Choose Slow begin the game. Let Continue Long end it.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 RHYTHM BEFORE DEPTH // PLAY
Stay with the sequence. You do not need to improve it.

1. Choose Slow — Choose a slow, comfortable pace in which inhale and exhale feel smooth.
2. Use Quiet — Use a quiet timer or gentle movement as metronome, never forcing lung volume.
3. Continue Long — Continue long enough to find a repeatable rhythm, then remove the metronome and keep one easy cycle.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Continue Long and leave the game there.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS

GAME MOVE
Enter through Pick Requires; leave as soon as you reach Complete Few. One pass is enough.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE EVEN BRIDGE // PLAY
Play the moves, not the whole life story.

1. Pick Requires — Pick a count that requires no effort.
2. Count Exhale — Inhale for that count, exhale for the same count, and leave any natural pause untouched.
3. Imagine Pair — Imagine each pair forming equal sides of a bridge.
4. Complete Few — Complete a few balanced crossings, then let counting dissolve.

⚡ DONE — Complete Complete Few, then return to your day.

rituals.unique_game_move: Move through the sequence once, from Sit to Finish Nostrils.

rituals.immediate_need: Move attention left and right until state feels organised.

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Move attention left and right until state feels organised.

GAME MOVE
Move through the sequence once, from Sit to Finish Nostrils.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 ALTERNATE THE AIRWAY // PLAY
Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.

1. Sit — Sit comfortably.
2. Close Nostril — Without force, close one nostril and breathe through the other; switch sides for the next gentle cycle.
3. Continue Unhurried — Continue alternating with an unhurried hand.
4. Keep Breath — Keep the breath quiet and abandon retention.
5. Finish Nostrils — Finish with both nostrils open.

⚡ FINISH — Finish Nostrils closes the round.
rituals.potency_stack:

1. Before you begin Sit, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Continue Unhurried, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
3. When you reach Finish Nostrils, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The useful rule here is simple: Move attention left and right until state feels organised.

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 VIBRATION ON THE WAY OUT // PLAY
Follow the sequence once; leave the rest alone.

1. Take Ordinary — Take an ordinary inhale.
2. Leave Feeling — Hum at a soft, comfortable pitch as air leaves, feeling vibration in lips, face, or chest.
3. Stop Empty — Stop before empty.
4. Listen Silence — Listen to the silence after the hum, then decide whether another round would still feel kind.

⚡ END MOVE — Listen Silence. No second lap.

🎮 OCEAN IN THE THROAT // PLAY

OCEAN IN THE THROAT

TRIGGER
Panic & body alarm

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
When you are trying too hard to make your breathing feel right, Ocean In The Throat makes the invisible part of the pattern easier to catch.

GOAL
Use barely audible sound as a pace rail.

GAME MOVE
Use Create Soft as the doorway and Release Technique as the exit.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 OCEAN IN THE THROAT // PLAY
One pass is enough. Follow what is written.

1. Create Soft — Narrow the throat only enough to create a soft ocean texture, never a rasp.
2. Let Sound — Let that sound accompany an easy inhale and exhale.
3. Reduce Effort — Reduce effort until someone beside you might barely hear it.
4. Release Technique — After several waves, release the technique completely.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — Release Technique is your cue to stop.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. As you enter Create Soft, feel where your body is supported for one moment.
2. At Reduce Effort, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach Release Technique, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Let this be the line you keep: Use barely audible sound as a pace rail.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You reach Release Technique without having to solve the entire situation.

📸 MY RESULT
“I let my breath breathe itself.”

FORMULA FLOW
Create Soft → Let Sound → Reduce Effort → Release Technique

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A large release can become several manageable ones.

GAME MOVE
Open at Let Air; close at Wait Body. Keep it light and literal.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 EXHALE IN CHAPTERS // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Let Air — Instead of one continuous out-breath, let air leave in three soft portions with tiny unforced spaces between.
2. Keep Face — Keep the face loose and never push to empty.
3. Wait Body — After the final segment, wait for the body’s next inhale rather than grabbing it.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Wait Body be enough.

rituals.how_to_play:

One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

PLAY TIME

HOOK
The Return Rep is for the moment when good enough is being rejected unless it is flawless—before the reaction gets to choose for you.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Attention strengthens on the comeback, not the stay.

GAME MOVE
Begin with Select Neutral. Move straight through to End After—no extra analysing.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE RETURN REP // PLAY
Keep it literal. One round, then out.

1. Select Neutral — Select one neutral anchor.
2. Attention — Each time distraction appears, notice where attention went and escort it back without commentary.
3. Count Rather — Count returns rather than uninterrupted seconds.
4. End After — End after ten honest comebacks, even if focus never felt perfect.

⚡ EXIT — Finish End After and leave the game there.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Give yourself one second before Select Neutral: soften your jaw and unclench your hands.
2. At Count Rather, try the opposite possibility for ten seconds.
3. When you reach End After, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The round ends on this idea: Attention strengthens on the comeback, not the stay.

TRIGGER
Rigid beliefs, labels & stories

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
When an old rule is being treated like a fact, try Let The Field Self-Publish. It makes the pattern easier to see and harder to obey.

GOAL
Observe experience without appointing a headline.

GAME MOVE
Touch Sit, follow the moves, and finish on Track Changing.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 LET THE FIELD SELF-PUBLISH // PLAY
Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

1. Sit — Sit with sight, sound, sensation, and thought available at once.
2. Whatever — Notice whatever becomes prominent, then what replaces it.
3. Dont Select — Do not select, rank, or hold any item.
4. Track Changing — Track the changing editorial order for one minute.

⚡ DONE — Complete Track Changing, then return to your day.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. At the start of Sit, widen your gaze and notice the edges of the room.
2. At Dont Select, try the opposite possibility for ten seconds.
3. When you reach Track Changing, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Remember the point: Observe experience without appointing a headline.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
The exercise gives you enough room to make Track Changing intentional.

📸 MY RESULT
“I found a rule I had never actually chosen.”

FORMULA FLOW
Sit → Whatever → Dont Select → Track Changing

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Receive what arrives without keeping or ejecting it.

GAME MOVE
Start at Let Field. Stop at End Whole. Let the middle do the work.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 NO FAVOURITE SENSATION // PLAY
One short round. Nothing to solve beyond the moves.

1. Let Field — Let the field choose its next foreground.
2. Pleasant — Pleasant, unpleasant, dull, or vivid—offer each the same brief hospitality.
3. Include Movement — When preference reaches to grip or reject, include that movement too.
4. End Whole — End by noticing the whole room at once.

⚡ FINISH — End Whole closes the round.
rituals.potency_stack:

1. Before you begin Let Field, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Include Movement, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
3. When you reach End Whole, choose one action that fits the facts you found. If you remember one thing, make it this: Receive what arrives without keeping or ejecting it.

PLAY TIME

HOOK

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Name enough to see; not enough to build a story.

GAME MOVE
Start with Apply Quiet. When Name Producing appears, the round is over.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 ONE-WORD LIGHT TOUCH // PLAY
Play it once. No bonus analysis.

1. Apply Quiet — As events arise, apply a quiet category: hearing, planning, heat, remembering, pressure.
2. Use Word — Use one word once, then return to the raw event.
3. Name Producing — If a Name starts producing analysis, Name that ‘explaining’ and release it.

⚡ END MOVE — Name Producing. No second lap.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Just before you start Apply Quiet, notice one sound in the room before continuing.
2. At Use Word, try the opposite possibility for ten seconds.
3. When you reach Name Producing, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Use this as the exit rule: Name enough to see; not enough to build a story.

Give yourself one clean run: Acknowledge first, Carry Final last.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 EXPAND–GATHER–EXPAND // PLAY
Play the moves, not the whole life story.

1. Acknowledge — First, acknowledge the full weather of the moment.
2. Breathe Small — Next, gather attention around breathing as a small centre.
3. Widen Whole — Finally, widen to the whole body and surrounding space.
4. Spend — Spend roughly one minute in each shape.
5. Carry Final — Carry the final wide frame into your next movement.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Carry Final, you are done.

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Walking can become a moving attention track.

GAME MOVE
Play from Place Weight to Finish Walking. Treat the last move as the finish line.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 FOUR PARTS OF ONE STEP // PLAY
Follow the sequence once; leave the rest alone.

1. Place Weight — Slow enough to distinguish lift, travel, place, and weight transfer.
2. Follow Events — Follow those four events through several steps.
3. Thought — When thought pulls away, rejoin at whichever phase the foot is currently performing.
4. Finish Walking — Finish by walking normally while retaining one point of contact.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Finish Walking and release the exercise.
rituals.potency_stack:

1. To open Place Weight, slow the next movement by about half.
2. At Thought, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
3. When you reach Finish Walking, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Your takeaway: Walking can become a moving attention track.

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Turn attention toward the fact that experience is known.

GAME MOVE
Enter through Choose Sensation; leave as soon as you reach Return Fact. One pass is enough.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 NOTICE THE NOTICING // PLAY
Run the game exactly once, lightly.

1. Choose Sensation — Choose any sensation.
2. Recognise — First recognise its qualities.
3. Ask Verbally — Then ask, without answering verbally, ‘How is this already known?’ Rest with the immediacy of knowing rather than searching for an object called awareness.
4. Return Fact — Return by naming one visible fact.

⚡ DONE — Complete Return Fact, then return to your day.

rituals.unique_game_move: Move through the sequence once, from Follow Inhale to Allow Breaths.
rituals.recognition_cue: When you are trying too hard to make your breathing feel right, The Breath Hinge gives you something concrete to do with the moment.
rituals.situation: When you are trying too hard to make your breathing feel right, The Breath Hinge gives you something concrete to do with the moment.

rituals.challenge: Rest where one phase becomes another.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Panic & body alarm

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
When you are trying too hard to make your breathing feel right, The Breath Hinge gives you something concrete to do with the moment.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Rest where one phase becomes another.

GAME MOVE
Move through the sequence once, from Follow Inhale to Allow Breaths.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE BREATH HINGE // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Follow Inhale — Follow a natural inhale to the instant it turns toward exhale.
2. Dont Hold — Do not hold or stretch the hinge.
3. Change — Notice the same effortless change at the bottom of exhalation.
4. Allow Breaths — Visit each threshold lightly, then allow several breaths to pass unwatched.

⚡ FINISH — Allow Breaths closes the round.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Before you begin Follow Inhale, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Change, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach Allow Breaths, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Carry this rule with you: Rest where one phase becomes another.

📸 MY RESULT

3. When you reach Allow Breaths, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Carry this rule with you: Rest where one phase becomes another.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You can reach Allow Breaths with more choice than you had at Follow Inhale.

📸 MY RESULT
“I let my breath breathe itself.”

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 WHERE SOUND BECOMES HEARING // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

1. Listen Sustained — Listen to a sustained, gentle sound.

GOAL
Let vision teach attention another size.

GAME MOVE
Use Open Sky as the doorway and Allow Attention as the exit.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 BORROW THE SKY’S WIDTH // PLAY
Keep it literal. One round, then out.

1. Open Sky — Gaze softly into open sky or another unobstructed safe field.
2. Release Pinpoint — Release pinpoint focus and include the edges of vision.
3. Compare Width — Without forcing calm, compare the width outside with the contraction inside.
4. Allow Attention — Allow attention to occupy both.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — Allow Attention is your cue to stop.

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 BEFORE THE SENTENCE // PLAY
Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.

1. Hold Attention — Hold attention quietly and wait.
2. Earliest — When a thought begins, notice its earliest form: pressure, fragment, image, word, or sense of where you are.
3. Dont Chase — Do not chase backward after it fully forms.
4. Birth — Simply Notice ‘birth’ and let the completed thought continue.

⚡ FINISH — Birth closes the round.

🎮 FOLLOW IT TO ZERO // PLAY

rituals.name: NOT FOR, NOT AGAINST
rituals.unique_game_move: Give yourself one clean run: Whether first, Act According last.
rituals.recognition_cue: Not For, Not Against is a tiny mind game for the moment when one rejection is starting to feel bigger than the whole picture.
rituals.situation: Not For, Not Against is a tiny mind game for the moment when one rejection is starting to feel bigger than the whole picture.
rituals.immediate_need: Release both hands of mental grasping.
rituals.challenge: Release both hands of mental grasping.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Comparison & rejection

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
Not For, Not Against is a tiny mind game for the moment when one rejection is starting to feel bigger than the whole picture.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Release both hands of mental grasping.

GAME MOVE
Give yourself one clean run: Whether first, Act According last.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 NOT FOR, NOT AGAINST // PLAY
Run the game exactly once, lightly.

1. Whether — Notice whether experience is being pulled closer or pushed away.
2. Relax — Relax the corresponding inner movement without demanding neutrality.
3. Let Content — Let the content remain unowned and unobstructed for a short interval.
4. Act According — Then act according to circumstance, not attraction or aversion.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Act According, you are done.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. When you arrive at Whether, press both feet down for three seconds.
2. At Let Content, separate responsibility from punishment.
3. When you reach Act According, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Keep only this lesson: Release both hands of mental grasping.

📸 MY RESULT
“A rejection hurt; it didn't get to define my value.”

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 ENOUGH IS A CURRENT FACT // PLAY
One short round. Nothing to solve beyond the moves.

1. Identify Part — Spot one part of the present condition that is genuinely adequate: shelter, breath, effort, support, knowledge, or time for the next step.
2. Receive Adequacy — Receive that adequacy without claiming everything is fine.
3. Choose Non — From this base, choose one non-desperate improvement.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Non closes the round.

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Remove identities without attacking experience.

GAME MOVE
Open at Body; close at Rest Unlabelled. Keep it light and literal.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 NOT THIS, STILL HERE // PLAY
Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.

1. Body — Notice body, sensation, thought, emotion, and role in turn.
2. Dont Claim — For each say, ‘Observed—therefore not the whole observer.’ Do not claim they are unreal.
3. Rest Unlabelled — After the sequence, rest with what remains unlabelled, then reconnect to name and place.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Rest Unlabelled be enough.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Right before the first move, Body, let one breath happen without trying to improve it.
2. At Dont Claim, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach Rest Unlabelled, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The useful rule here is simple: Remove identities without attacking experience.

rituals.game_move: Open at Body; close at Rest Unlabelled. Keep it light and literal.
rituals.how_to_play:
🎮 NOT THIS, STILL HERE // PLAY
Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.

1. Body — Notice body, sensation, thought, emotion, and role in turn.
2. Dont Claim — For each say, ‘Observed—therefore not the whole observer.’ Do not claim they are unreal.
3. Rest Unlabelled — After the sequence, rest with what remains unlabelled, then reconnect to name and place.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Rest Unlabelled be enough.
rituals.power_up_1: Right before the first move, Body, let one breath happen without trying to improve it.
rituals.power_up_2: At Dont Claim, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
rituals.power_up_3: When you reach Rest Unlabelled, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The useful rule here is simple: Remove identities without attacking experience.
rituals.win_reward_raw:
🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You can finish at Rest Unlabelled even if the original thought has not completely disappeared.

📸 MY RESULT
“I found one safe point of contact with the present.”
rituals.formula_flow_raw: Body → Dont Claim → Rest Unlabelled

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 WHO RECEIVED THAT THOUGHT? // PLAY
Follow the sequence once; leave the rest alone.

1. Ask Whom — When a thought appears, ask ‘To whom did this occur?’ If ‘me’ arises, ask ‘What is this me before the answer?’ Refuse biography, role, body description, and philosophy.
2. Hold Question — Stay with the question’s open edge for several heartbeats.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Hold Question and release the exercise.
