TRIGGER
Evidence distortion & selective thinking

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes

HOOK
Set The Contact Dose is a tiny mind game for the moment when your mind has turned everything into all-or-nothing.

GOAL
Closeness can be realistic instead of accepted or abandoned completely.

GAME MOVE
Touch Choose Frequency, follow the moves, and finish on Use Body.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 SET THE CONTACT DOSE // PLAY
Run the game exactly once, lightly.

1. Choose Frequency — Before contact, choose frequency, duration, permitted topics, location, and exit phrase.
2. Start Lowest — Start with the lowest dose that preserves both connection and regulation.
3. Use Body — Review afterward using body and behaviour, not guilt.

⚡ DONE — Complete Use Body, then return to your day.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. At the start of Choose Frequency, widen your gaze and notice the edges of the room.
2. At Start Lowest, look for the piece of evidence your first reaction ignored.
3. When you reach Use Body, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Keep only this lesson: Closeness can be realistic instead of accepted or abandoned completely.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
The old reaction loses a little speed before Use Body.

📸 MY RESULT
“It wasn't 0 or 10. There was a real number in between.”

Choose Frequency → Start Lowest → Use Body

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 POSTURE WITHOUT PROPHECY // PLAY
Keep it literal. One round, then out.

1. Adopt — Adopt a stable, non-defensive position: feet supported, spine available, gaze level, arms unguarded enough for safety. clearly refuse both positive and negative…
2. Hold Posture — Hold the posture while waiting for actual evidence.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — Hold Posture is your cue to stop.

1. As you enter Adopt, feel where your body is supported for one moment.
2. At Hold Posture, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach Hold Posture, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The round ends on this idea: The body can stop rehearsing defeat before facts arrive.

rituals.name: SOFT JAW, SAME BOUNDARY
rituals.unique_game_move: Give yourself one clean run: Jaw first, Let Articulation last.
rituals.recognition_cue: When your responsibility and someone else's have blurred together, try Soft Jaw, Same Boundary. It makes the pattern easier to see and harder to obey.
rituals.situation: When your responsibility and someone else's have blurred together, try Soft Jaw, Same Boundary. It makes the pattern easier to see and harder to obey.
rituals.immediate_need: Reduce aggression preparation without weakening the sentence.
rituals.challenge: Reduce aggression preparation without weakening the sentence.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Boundaries & over-responsibility

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
When your responsibility and someone else's have blurred together, try Soft Jaw, Same Boundary. It makes the pattern easier to see and harder to obey.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Reduce aggression preparation without weakening the sentence.

GAME MOVE
Give yourself one clean run: Jaw first, Let Articulation last.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 SOFT JAW, SAME BOUNDARY // PLAY
Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

1. Jaw — Notice jaw pressure before speaking.
2. Separate Teeth — Separate the teeth, relax the tongue, and exhale naturally.
3. Deliver Limit — Deliver the exact limit you planned—no extra smile, apology, or attack.
4. Let Articulation — Let articulation stay clear while muscular threat signalling drops.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Let Articulation, you are done.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. When you arrive at Jaw, press both feet down for three seconds.
2. At Deliver Limit, separate responsibility from punishment.
3. When you reach Let Articulation, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Remember the point: Reduce aggression preparation without weakening the sentence.

📸 MY RESULT
“I found where my responsibility ends.”

rituals.name: CHOOSE THE EASIEST MISTAKE TO CATCH
rituals.ritual_name: CHOOSE THE EASIEST MISTAKE TO CATCH
rituals.unique_game_move: Begin where it says Name Options; stop the moment you complete Choose Visible.
rituals.recognition_cue: Choose The Easiest Mistake To Catch catches the moment when a strong feeling is starting to sound like a fact and gives you another route.
rituals.situation: Choose The Easiest Mistake To Catch catches the moment when a strong feeling is starting to sound like a fact and gives you another route.
rituals.immediate_need: A safer choice may be the mistake you can see early enough to correct.
rituals.challenge: A safer choice may be the mistake you can see early enough to correct.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Emotional reasoning

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes

HOOK
Choose The Easiest Mistake To Catch catches the moment when a strong feeling is starting to sound like a fact and gives you another route.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A safer choice may be the mistake you can see early enough to correct.

GAME MOVE
Begin where it says Name Options; stop the moment you complete Choose Visible.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 CHOOSE THE EASIEST MISTAKE TO CATCH // PLAY
One short round. Nothing to solve beyond the moves.

1. Name Options — Name the two or three live options. For each, Picture the specific way it could fail—not a vague fear.
2. Name Failure — Name the earliest observable sign that failure has begun. It must be visible or clear, not a feeling alone.
3. Warning — State what corrective action would still be available when that sign appears and what cost has already accumulated.
4. Choose Visible — Prefer the option whose reliable warning arrives while correction is still practical. Use this as one decision criterion, not the whole verdict.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Choose Visible be enough.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Right before the first move, Name Options, let one breath happen without trying to improve it.
2. At Warning, give the feeling a name without letting it make the decision.
3. When you reach Choose Visible, choose one action that fits the facts you found. If you remember one thing, make it this: A safer choice may be the mistake you can see early enough to correct.

rituals.win_reward:
🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You reach Choose Visible with a clearer distinction between the reaction and the response.

📸 MY RESULT
“The feeling was real. It still wasn't the whole evidence.”
rituals.formula_flow: Name Options → Name Failure → Warning → Choose Visible

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 FIND THE MOMENT THE FLOOR CATCHES YOU // PLAY
Play it once. No bonus analysis.

1. Shift Weight — Stand safely and shift weight slowly left, centre, right, then forward and back.
2. Identify Instant — At each transition, spot the exact instant the receiving foot supports you.
3. Finish Centre — Finish at centre and name the strongest contact point.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Finish Centre and release the exercise.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. To open Shift Weight, slow the next movement by about half.
2. At Identify Instant, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach Finish Centre, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Use this as the exit rule: Panic can obscure support that never disappeared.

Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.

1. Choose Pressure — Choose pressure from a surface, steady gaze, mild temperature, and slow movement.
2. Check Sequence — Sequence them without checking breathing.
3. Channel — Notice which channel restores the clearest sense of where you are and keep only that one for the final interval.

⚡ FINISH — Channel closes the round.

1. Before you begin Choose Pressure, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Check Sequence, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
3. When you reach Channel, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The useful rule here is simple: When respiration is a trigger, use other doors.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You can hold the discomfort and still make the move at Channel.

📸 MY RESULT
“I stopped circling and found the next useful point.”

Choose Pressure → Check Sequence → Channel

Run the game exactly once, lightly.

rituals.name: SORT THE SOUNDS BY DISTANCE
rituals.unique_game_move: One round only: enter at Identify Nearest, finish at Let Far.
rituals.recognition_cue: Use Sort The Sounds By Distance when the fastest response feels like the only response. It turns the reaction into a small experiment.
rituals.situation: Use Sort The Sounds By Distance when the fastest response feels like the only response. It turns the reaction into a small experiment.
rituals.immediate_need: Urgency shrinks when hearing regains depth.
rituals.challenge: Urgency shrinks when hearing regains depth.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Urgency & decision pressure

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
Use Sort The Sounds By Distance when the fastest response feels like the only response. It turns the reaction into a small experiment.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Urgency shrinks when hearing regains depth.

GAME MOVE
One round only: enter at Identify Nearest, finish at Let Far.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 SORT THE SOUNDS BY DISTANCE // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

1. Identify Nearest — Spot the nearest sound, one mid-distance sound, and the farthest audible layer.
2. Move Attention — Move attention outward through those distances, then back once.
3. Let Far — Let the far sound widen the perceived space around the closest one.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Let Far and release the exercise.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. To open Identify Nearest, slow the next movement by about half.
2. At Move Attention, ask, “What can I do in under two minutes?”.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THREE TEMPERATURE FACTS // PLAY
Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

1. Check Temperature — Check temperature at three locations: hands, face, and where clothing meets skin.
2. Use Comparative — Use comparative language—cooler, warmer, neutral—rather than guessing degrees.
3. Let Readings — Let the three readings define the body’s current climate.

⚡ DONE — Complete Let Readings, then return to your day.

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 SCENT THE RETURN // PLAY
Play it once. No bonus analysis.

1. Choose Safe — Choose a safe, mild, distinctive scent.
2. Use After — Use it only after you have genuinely returned to present time and choice.
3. Date Grounding — Pair it with date, place, and one grounding action across several occasions.
4. Test Whether — Later, test whether the scent helps retrieve that state.

⚡ END MOVE — Test Whether. No second lap.

rituals.play_the_loop:

🎮 FIND THE SENSE FACT THE STORY CANNOT EXPLAIN // PLAY
Play the moves, not the whole life story.

1. State Fear — State the feared scenario.
2. Search Sensory — Search for one sensory fact opposite with it: an unlocked exit, ordinary background conversation, relaxed posture nearby, intact support, current silence.
3. Predict Fact — Explain in one line why the model fails to predict that fact.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Predict Fact, you are done.

3. When you reach Predict Fact, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Keep the clean version: Threat models dislike contradictory present data.

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 COUNT EVERY OPEN LOOP // PLAY
One pass is enough. Follow what is written.

1. Question Task — Name every unresolved promise, question, task, decision, and waiting item without solving any.
2. Use Line — Use one line each.
3. Imagine Boundary — When nothing else appears for thirty seconds, Imagine a boundary around the inventory and choose a separate processing time.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Imagine Boundary and leave the game there.

1. Give yourself one second before Question Task: soften your jaw and unclench your hands.
2. At Use Line, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
3. When you reach Imagine Boundary, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Let this be the line you keep: Invisible commitments keep using memory until named.

rituals.name: ONE ACTIVE SLOT
rituals.unique_game_move: Enter through Create Positions; leave as soon as you reach Give Active. One pass is enough.
rituals.recognition_cue: One Active Slot is a tiny mind game for the moment when your mind is carrying too many things at once.
rituals.situation: One Active Slot is a tiny mind game for the moment when your mind is carrying too many things at once.
rituals.immediate_need: Short-term attention needs a deliberate admission policy.
rituals.challenge: Short-term attention needs a deliberate admission policy.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Attention & cognitive overload

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
One Active Slot is a tiny mind game for the moment when your mind is carrying too many things at once.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Short-term attention needs a deliberate admission policy.

GAME MOVE
Enter through Create Positions; leave as soon as you reach Give Active. One pass is enough.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 ONE ACTIVE SLOT // PLAY
Run the game exactly once, lightly.

1. Create Positions — Create three positions: ACTIVE, WAITING, ARCHIVE.
2. Wait Route — Put only one concern in active, one likely next item in waiting, and route everything else to archive with a retrieval Notice.
3. Give Active — Give the active concern a protected time box.

⚡ DONE — Complete Give Active, then return to your day.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. At the start of Create Positions, widen your gaze and notice the edges of the room.
2. At Wait Route, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
3. When you reach Give Active, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Keep only this lesson: Short-term attention needs a deliberate admission policy.

rituals.title: HIDE THE OPTION NAMES
rituals.name: HIDE THE OPTION NAMES
rituals.unique_game_move: Move through the sequence once, from Mask Names to Reveal Options.
rituals.recognition_cue: When someone else's life has become the ruler for yours, Hide The Option Names gives you something concrete to do with the moment.
rituals.situation: When someone else's life has become the ruler for yours, Hide The Option Names gives you something concrete to do with the moment.
rituals.immediate_need: See what the options look like before their names start campaigning.
rituals.challenge: See what the options look like before their names start campaigning.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Comparison & rejection

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes

HOOK
When someone else's life has become the ruler for yours, Hide The Option Names gives you something concrete to do with the moment.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
See what the options look like before their names start campaigning.

GAME MOVE
Move through the sequence once, from Mask Names to Reveal Options.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 HIDE THE OPTION NAMES // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Mask Names — Ask someone—or a shuffled Notice—to rename the leading options A, B and C without showing which is which.
2. Choose Traits — Choose three relevant traits, such as cost, time, fit, reliability, or learning. Keep safety facts visible.
3. Rank Blind — Compare the symbols on those traits without guessing their identities and Hold the current order.
4. Reveal Options — Reveal the names. Keep the blind order or name exactly what Name changed it and why.

⚡ FINISH — Reveal Options closes the round.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Before you begin Mask Names, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Rank Blind, separate what you know from what you are predicting.
3. When you reach Reveal Options, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Carry this rule with you: See what the options look like before their names start campaigning.

rituals.win_reward:
🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You can reach Reveal Options with more choice than you had at Mask Names.

📸 MY RESULT
“I stopped measuring my whole life against one snapshot.”
rituals.formula_flow: Mask Names → Choose Traits → Rank Blind → Reveal Options

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

🎮 GROUP BY BRAIN MODE // PLAY

1. Sort By Mind Mode — Group tasks into simple types such as talking, reading, errands, decisions, or admin.

3. Finish The Block — Complete that block before changing to a different kind of task.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — Finish The Block is your cue to stop.

Start at Begin Anyway. Stop at Test Momentum. Let the middle do the work.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 MOVE BEFORE MOTIVATION // PLAY
Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.

1. Begin Anyway — State honestly: ‘Motivation may stay absent.’ Begin the earliest physical component anyway—stand, open, carry, type, dial.
2. Complete Unit — Continue only through one contained unit.
3. Test Momentum — Let action provide data about whether more is possible.

⚡ FINISH — Test Momentum closes the round.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Before you begin Begin Anyway, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Complete Unit, give the feeling a name without letting it make the decision.
3. When you reach Test Momentum, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The useful rule here is simple: Feeling ready is not a legal requirement for the first motion.

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 PREVIEW THE AFTER // PLAY
Run the game exactly once, lightly.

1. Protect Enjoyed — Construct a ten-second scene immediately after completion: what is lighter, available, learned, protected, or enjoyed?
2. Include Sensory — Include a sensory marker plus one practical consequence.
3. State Accessible — Begin the task while that specific after-state remains accessible.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach State Accessible, you are done.

3. When you reach State Accessible, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Keep only this lesson: Delayed reward is undercounted because the mind cannot feel it yet.

GOAL

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 FIND YOUR WORKING GEAR // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

1. Run Pulse — Choose one ordinary task and run it for exactly thirty seconds without trying to finish it.
2. Full Stop — Stop completely for fifteen seconds. Hands off, eyes away, and no planning the next move.
3. Read Strain — Rate actual strain as light, workable, heavy, or stop. Compare it with what you predicted before starting.
4. Set Gear — Choose the next gear—30/15, 60/30, or stop—and complete exactly one more cycle at that ratio.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Set Gear and release the exercise.

Keep it literal. One round, then out.

Enter through Create Prior; leave as soon as you reach Choose Action. One pass is enough.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 HARVEST THE PROOF OF PROGRESS // PLAY
Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

1. Create Prior — Collect three concrete differences created by prior effort—speed, quality, recovery time, knowledge, frequency, distance.
2. Date Examples — Attach dates or examples.
3. Choose Action — Choose the next action that becomes reasonable because one difference now exists.

⚡ DONE — Complete Choose Action, then return to your day.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. At the start of Create Prior, widen your gaze and notice the edges of the room.
2. At Date Examples, ask, “What can I do in under two minutes?”.
3. When you reach Choose Action, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Remember the point: Gains must be stored before motivation can spend them.

THREE INCOMPATIBLE READINGS

TRIGGER
Uncertainty & reassurance seeking

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes

HOOK
Use Three Incompatible Readings when not knowing feels like something you must fix immediately. It turns the reaction into a small experiment.

GOAL
Uncertainty is not evidence for your favourite meaning.

GAME MOVE
Start with Hold Cue. When Receive Support appears, the round is over.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THREE INCOMPATIBLE READINGS // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

1. Hold Cue — Hold the same cue—a delayed reply, expression, result.
2. Identify Future — Generate three explanations that cannot all be true and spot what future evidence would discriminate among them.
3. Receive Support — Delay commitment until one prediction receives support.

⚡ END MOVE — Receive Support. No second lap.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Just before you start Hold Cue, notice one sound in the room before continuing.
2. At Identify Future, try the opposite possibility for ten seconds.
3. When you reach Receive Support, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Take this line with you: Uncertainty is not evidence for your favourite meaning.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
At Receive Support, you have at least one option the first reaction did not show you.

📸 MY RESULT
“I just left one question unanswered and stayed okay enough.”

FORMULA FLOW
Hold Cue → Identify Future → Receive Support

🎮 THE POINT OF NO MORE INFLUENCE // PLAY
Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

rituals.hook: When not knowing feels like something you must fix immediately, try The Point Of No More Influence. It makes the pattern easier to see and harder to obey.
rituals.mission: The body needs to know when available action is complete.
rituals.game_move: Give yourself one clean run: Remain Unknown first, Use Physical last.
rituals.how_to_play:
🎮 THE POINT OF NO MORE INFLUENCE // PLAY
Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

1. Remain Unknown — Name what you have already done, what remains unknown, and which outcomes no longer respond to effort.
2. Boundary — Notice the exact boundary where influence ends.
3. Use Physical — Use one physical closing action and redirect into a present responsibility.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Use Physical, you are done.

rituals.power_up_2: At Boundary, try the opposite possibility for ten seconds.
rituals.power_up_3: When you reach Use Physical, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Remember the point: The body needs to know when available action is complete.

GOAL

GAME MOVE

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE LAST-DAY FILTER // PLAY
Stay with the sequence. You do not need to improve it.

1. Imagine Back — Imagine looking back from life’s end—not to frighten yourself, but to rank.
2. Demand — Which current demand disappears?
3. Remain Relationship — Which relationship, integrity choice, health need, or contribution remains?
4. Give Surviving — Give the surviving priority one concrete slot today.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Give Surviving and leave the game there.

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THIS IS A CHAPTER, NOT THE BOOK // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

1. Place Today — Place today’s event on a long timeline with past chapters already survived and blank space ahead.
2. Picture Future — Picture three future headings that remain possible but unknown.
3. Choose Sentence — Choose one sentence describing this chapter accurately without making it the title of the whole life.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Choose Sentence and release the exercise.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. To open Place Today, slow the next movement by about half.
2. At Picture Future, try the opposite possibility for ten seconds.
3. When you reach Choose Sentence, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Take this line with you: The present cannot forecast unopened pages.

rituals.title: CHANGE THE MENTAL TOOL, NOT THE PRESSURE
rituals.name: CHANGE THE MENTAL TOOL, NOT THE PRESSURE
rituals.ritual_name: CHANGE THE MENTAL TOOL, NOT THE PRESSURE
rituals.unique_game_move: Touch Decide Accept, follow the moves, and finish on Choose Shut.
rituals.recognition_cue: When your mind keeps delaying the first move, try Change The Mental Tool, Not The Pressure. It makes the pattern easier to see and harder to obey.
rituals.situation: When your mind keeps delaying the first move, try Change The Mental Tool, Not The Pressure. It makes the pattern easier to see and harder to obey.
rituals.immediate_need: Wrong mental mode makes effort repeat itself.
rituals.challenge: Wrong mental mode makes effort repeat itself.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Action avoidance & procrastination

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
When your mind keeps delaying the first move, try Change The Mental Tool, Not The Pressure. It makes the pattern easier to see and harder to obey.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Wrong mental mode makes effort repeat itself.

GAME MOVE
Touch Decide Accept, follow the moves, and finish on Choose Shut.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 CHANGE THE MENTAL TOOL, NOT THE PRESSURE // PLAY
Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

1. Decide Accept — Classify the demand as SOLVE, DECIDE, FEEL, ACCEPT, COMMUNICATE, or WAIT.
2. Name Mode — Name the mode currently running.
3. Choose Shut — Shut it down and perform the first action belonging to the correct mode—calculate, choose, allow, release, speak, or schedule.

⚡ DONE — Complete Choose Shut, then return to your day.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. At the start of Decide Accept, widen your gaze and notice the edges of the room.
2. At Name Mode, ask, “What can I do in under two minutes?”.
3. When you reach Choose Shut, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Remember the point: Wrong mental mode makes effort repeat itself.

rituals.potency_2: At Name Mode, ask, “What can I do in under two minutes?”.
rituals.potency_3: When you reach Choose Shut, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Remember the point: Wrong mental mode makes effort repeat itself.
rituals.win_reward:
🏆 WIN SIGNAL
The exercise gives you enough room to make Choose Shut intentional.

📸 MY RESULT
“I stopped waiting to feel ready and found one move I could do.”
rituals.formula_flow: Decide Accept → Name Mode → Choose Shut
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Mixed situations may need modes in sequence rather than one Name.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

Observer loss & cognitive fusion

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

When you have fallen inside the thought instead of noticing it, Demote The Headline Experience gives you something concrete to do with the moment.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Foreground and background can share equal status.

GAME MOVE
Move through the sequence once, from Hold Sensation to Focus.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 DEMOTE THE HEADLINE EXPERIENCE // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Hold Sensation — Hold the dominant sensation or thought with three background what you notices—one sound, one contact point, one visual feature.
2. Give Attention — For a contained interval, give all four equal attentional weight without imagining a separate watcher.
3. Focus — Notice how centrality changes.

⚡ FINISH — Focus closes the round.
rituals.potency_stack:

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Test whether the witness has a fixed address.

GAME MOVE
Take the shortest route: Search Carefully → the middle moves → Rest Inability.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 WHERE EXACTLY IS THE OBSERVER? // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

1. Search Carefully — Search carefully for the boundary, size, and location of the one who observes.
2. Check Behind — Check behind the eyes, chest, head, and surrounding field.
3. Observe Found — Every found sensation is itself observed.
4. Rest Inability — Rest with the inability to locate a final point.

⚡ END MOVE — Rest Inability. No second lap.

Attention & cognitive overload

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds

HOOK
Put The Commentator In The Cheap Seat catches the moment when your attention has narrowed until only one thing is visible and gives you another route.

GOAL
Let task feedback lead while self-opinion becomes background sound.

GAME MOVE
Open at Choose Skill; close at Finish Unit. Keep it light and literal.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 PUT THE COMMENTATOR IN THE CHEAP SEAT // PLAY
One short round. Nothing to solve beyond the moves.

1. Choose Skill — Choose one familiar, low-risk task with clear external feedback.
2. Centre Feedback — Put sight, touch, sound, or the work result in the centre of attention.
3. Demote Voice — When self-commentary appears, let it continue faintly at the edge without answering or silencing it.
4. Finish Unit — Finish one complete task unit using feedback—not self-opinion—to make corrections.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Finish Unit be enough.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Right before the first move, Choose Skill, let one breath happen without trying to improve it.
2. At Demote Voice, replace “definitely” with an honest percentage.
3. When you reach Finish Unit, choose one action that fits the facts you found. If you remember one thing, make it this: Let task feedback lead while self-opinion becomes background sound.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You reach Finish Unit with a clearer distinction between the reaction and the response.

📸 MY RESULT
“I widened the frame and found what the tunnel had hidden.”

FORMULA FLOW
Choose Skill → Centre Feedback → Demote Voice → Finish Unit

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 PLAY EMOTION JENGA // PLAY
Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.

1. Name Stack — Name two or three feelings and place each on a separate mental or your imagination block.
2. Pull One — Temporarily bracket one block with the phrase ‘not deleted—just outside this test.’
3. Check Remainder — Notice what changes in the remainder: body location, urge, story, intensity, or nothing at all. Keep one difference.
4. Rebuild Stack — Restore the removed block. Repeat only if useful, then rebuild the complete stack before finishing.

⚡ FINISH — Rebuild Stack closes the round.
rituals.potency_stack:

1. Before you begin Name Stack, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Check Remainder, give the feeling a name without letting it make the decision.
3. When you reach Rebuild Stack, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The useful rule here is simple: Pull one feeling from the stack and see what is actually holding.

rituals.unique_game_move: Play from Give Obstacle to Picture Negotiate. Treat the last move as the finish line.
rituals.recognition_cue: Use Interview The Obstacle when your mind keeps delaying the first move. It turns the reaction into a small experiment.
rituals.situation: Use Interview The Obstacle when your mind keeps delaying the first move. It turns the reaction into a small experiment.
rituals.immediate_need: Resistance may be protecting something your plan ignored.
rituals.challenge: Resistance may be protecting something your plan ignored.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Action avoidance & procrastination

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

HOOK
Use Interview The Obstacle when your mind keeps delaying the first move. It turns the reaction into a small experiment.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Resistance may be protecting something your plan ignored.

GAME MOVE
Play from Give Obstacle to Picture Negotiate. Treat the last move as the finish line.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 INTERVIEW THE OBSTACLE // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

1. Give Obstacle — Give the obstacle a character and ask three questions: What are you protecting?
2. Do — What do you fear will happen?
3. Make Step — What would make one step acceptable?
4. Picture Negotiate — Picture its answers, then negotiate a small action that protects the valid need without handing over total control.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Picture Negotiate and release the exercise.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. To open Give Obstacle, slow the next movement by about half.
2. At Make Step, ask, “What can I do in under two minutes?”.
3. When you reach Picture Negotiate, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Take this line with you: Resistance may be protecting something your plan ignored.

📸 MY RESULT
“I just stopped waiting to feel ready and found one move I could do.”

rituals.plain_text:
INTERVIEW THE OBSTACLE

TRIGGER
Action avoidance & procrastination

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

HOOK
Use Interview The Obstacle when your mind keeps delaying the first move. It turns the reaction into a small experiment.

GOAL
Resistance may be protecting something your plan ignored.

GAME MOVE
Play from Give Obstacle to Picture Negotiate. Treat the last move as the finish line.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 INTERVIEW THE OBSTACLE // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

1. Give Obstacle — Give the obstacle a character and ask three questions: What are you protecting?
2. Do — What do you fear will happen?
3. Make Step — What would make one step acceptable?
4. Picture Negotiate — Picture its answers, then negotiate a small action that protects the valid need without handing over total control.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Picture Negotiate and release the exercise.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. To open Give Obstacle, slow the next movement by about half.
2. At Make Step, ask, “What can I do in under two minutes?”.
3. When you reach Picture Negotiate, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Take this line with you: Resistance may be protecting something your plan ignored.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
At Picture Negotiate, the next move feels chosen rather than dictated.

📸 MY RESULT
“I just stopped waiting to feel ready and found one move I could do.”

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Sunk cost is history, not future value.

GAME MOVE
Start at Hide Already and keep going only until Reveal.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE PAST INVESTMENT GETS NO NEW VOTE // PLAY
Keep it literal. One round, then out.

1. Hide Already — Hide what has already been spent.
2. Compare Options — Compare options from today forward using remaining cost, likely benefit, opportunity cost, and risk.
3. Reveal — Reveal the past investment afterward only for learning, never for sharing.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — Reveal is your cue to stop.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. As you enter Hide Already, feel where your body is supported for one moment.
2. At Compare Options, ask, “What can I do in under two minutes?”.
3. When you reach Reveal, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The round ends on this idea: Sunk cost is history, not future value.

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 CONSTRAINTS ENTER BEFORE OPTIONS // PLAY
Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

1. Picture Safety — Picture safety, ethics, consent, resources, and timing constraints first.
2. Eliminate — Eliminate choices that violate them.
3. Generate — Generate options only inside the surviving space.
4. Treat — Treat creativity as solving within reality, not arguing with the boundary.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Treat, you are done.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 MOVE THE RULE BETWEEN WORLDS // PLAY
Play the moves, not the whole life story.

1. State Rule — Picture the rule without naming who taught it.
2. Change Context — Place it in three contrasting settings—for example family, workplace, and friendship—with different power and consequences.

rituals.plain:
CHANGE THE COMPARISON DENOMINATOR

TRIGGER
Comparison & rejection

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds

HOOK
When someone else's life has become the ruler for yours, Change The Comparison Denominator makes the invisible part of the pattern easier to catch.

GOAL
A distorted reference group can manufacture failure.

GAME MOVE
Use Name Mind as the doorway and Group Exists as the exit.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 CHANGE THE COMPARISON DENOMINATOR // PLAY
One pass is enough. Follow what is written.

1. Name Mind — Name the group your mind selected.
2. Match Resources — Substitute a baseline matched on starting point, resources, time, responsibilities, and opportunity.
3. Compare Progress — Compare progress with context included.
4. Group Exists — If no fair group exists, use your own prior trajectory.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — Group Exists is your cue to stop.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. As you enter Name Mind, feel where your body is supported for one moment.
2. At Compare Progress, replace “definitely” with an honest percentage.
3. When you reach Group Exists, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Let this be the line you keep: A distorted reference group can manufacture failure.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You reach Group Exists without having to solve the entire situation.

📸 MY RESULT
“I stopped measuring my whole life against one snapshot.”

FORMULA FLOW
Name Mind → Match Resources → Compare Progress → Group Exists

Run the game exactly once, lightly.

1. Picture Culturally — Picture the culturally expected next step.
2. Name Benefits — Name who benefits, what value it serves, and what it costs you.

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 DO ONE GOOD THING WITH NO APPLAUSE BUTTON // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Choose Safe — Choose a safe act you endorse and perform it without announcing, checking reactions, or fishing for reassurance.
2. Let Discomfort — Let the discomfort of no feedback rise and change.
3. Review — Review the action by your values afterward.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Review be enough.

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 RETURN THE SHAME TO ITS OLD ADDRESS // PLAY
Keep it literal. One round, then out.

1. Identify Whose — Spot whose rule the shame is enforcing and the setting where it was learned.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Keep Repair and leave the game there.
